name: Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program
description: California's Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program provides screening, case management, and environmental investigation to protect children from lead exposure, which can cause learning disabilities and developmental delays.
fullDescription: California's Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program provides screening, case management, and environmental investigation to protect children from lead exposure, which can cause learning disabilities and developmental delays.
whatTheyOffer:
- Blood lead screening guidance for children (testing is covered by Medi-Cal)
- Case management for children with elevated lead levels
- Environmental investigation of lead sources
- Home assessment and lead hazard identification
- Nutritional counseling
- Connection to developmental services
- Education for parents and caregivers
howToGetIt: Under updated state screening rules (effective July 6, 2026), almost all California children should get a blood lead test at ages 1 and 2 - ask your child's doctor. Contact your local health department's lead program if your child has been exposed to lead or you're concerned about lead in your home.
keywords: lead poisoning, blood test, lead paint, children, developmental delay, learning disability, lead hazard, home inspection, free testing
